reply:
Correct. Amending rewrites the commit, changing its hash. That forces teammates to either reset their branches (losing any work not pushed) or create merge conflicts when they try to push. For a commit already pulled by others, the cost of a force push outweighs fixing a typo in the message.

Leave it or add a follow-up commit with the correction. That's the right call.

grade.note: Reply agrees with developer, correctly explains hash change and force-push disruption.
